title: 22 January 1947 — The Objectives Resolution Is Adopted
summary: Final reply and standing adoption of the Objectives Resolution, followed by the Bhutan-Sikkim resolution and debate over the Assembly budget.

title: Objectives Resolution — Adoption
summary: The Assembly moves from six weeks of debate to a standing vote after the final reply and withdrawal of the remaining amendments.

title: Bhutan and Sikkim — Negotiating Committee
summary: The Assembly extends the States Negotiating Committee's scope to Bhutan and Sikkim.

title: Assembly Budget — Public or in Committee?
summary: A procedural disagreement over transparency accompanies consideration of the Assembly's expenditure.
